description: Desktop light: start one guest live-collaboration session from the share dialog, record URL fragment shape and dialog, then stop the session. Run once; do not repeat in loops. Privacy: the dialog screenshot masks every input and image in the dialog (the link and its QR code), the in-session screenshot is refused while any dialog is open, and ARIA text is redacted by the driver. In s1 these protections did not exist; those captures were removed (see methodology). Do not run REA tools during this scenario: REA target listings keep URL fragments. From s6 on, its emulate step is an assertMetrics step and only 00 emulates. In s5 the re-applied override read back the headless default screen (800x600) because the preceding Playwright screenshot had reset the emulated screen metrics; that was later reproduced on a self-authored fixture, and the driver now captures through CDP instead.
